from solution import is_majority


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example from issue: [1,2,3,3,3,3,10] with x=3 is majority."""
    result = is_majority([1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 10], 7, 3)
    # count of 3 is 4; 4 > 7/2 = 3.5 so True
    assert result == True


def test_issue_majority_at_start():
    """Check for majority element when majority block is at the start."""
    result = is_majority([2, 2, 2, 2, 5, 6, 7], 7, 2)
    # count of 2 is 4; 4 > 7/2 = 3.5 so True
    assert result == True


def test_issue_majority_at_end():
    """Check for majority element when majority block is at the end."""
    result = is_majority([1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 4, 4], 7, 4)
    # count of 4 is 4; 4 > 7/2 = 3.5 so True
    assert result == True


def test_issue_below_threshold_not_majority():
    """Check for majority element returns False when count is below half."""
    result = is_majority([1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6], 7, 3)
    # count of 3 is 2; 2 > 7/2 = 3.5 is false so False
    assert result == False


def test_issue_exact_half_not_majority():
    """Majority needs strictly more than half, so exactly half is False."""
    result = is_majority([1, 1, 2, 2], 4, 1)
    # count of 1 is 2; 2 > 4/2 = 2 is false so False
    assert result == False


def test_issue_just_over_half_is_majority():
    """Majority holds when count is just above half."""
    result = is_majority([1, 1, 1, 2], 4, 1)
    # count of 1 is 3; 3 > 4/2 = 2 so True
    assert result == True


def test_issue_middle_match_without_majority():
    """Middle element matching x alone does not imply majority."""
    result = is_majority([1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 5], 7, 3)
    # count of 3 is 3; 3 > 7/2 = 3.5 is false so False
    assert result == False


def test_issue_absent_element_not_majority():
    """Check for majority element returns False when x is absent."""
    result = is_majority([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 5, 6)
    # count of 6 is 0; 0 > 5/2 = 2.5 is false so False
    assert result == False


def test_issue_single_element_majority():
    """Single-element sorted array holds its only element as majority."""
    result = is_majority([5], 1, 5)
    # count of 5 is 1; 1 > 1/2 = 0.5 so True
    assert result == True


def test_issue_empty_array_no_majority():
    """Check for majority element in empty array returns False."""
    result = is_majority([], 0, 1)
    # count of 1 is 0; 0 > 0/2 = 0 is false so False
    assert result == False


def test_contract_true_for_clear_majority():
    """Contract: is_majority must return True when x is a clear majority."""
    result = is_majority([1, 1, 1, 1, 2], 5, 1)
    # count of 1 is 4; 4 > 5/2 = 2.5 so True
    assert result == True


def test_contract_false_for_clear_non_majority():
    """Contract: is_majority must return False when x is clearly not majority."""
    result = is_majority([1, 1, 2, 2, 3], 5, 1)
    # count of 1 is 2; 2 > 5/2 = 2.5 is false so False
    assert result == False
